answer: Look at the yarrow and you see a craftsperson's years, look at the juniper and you see a purse's depth, look at the ivory and you see a calendar's patience. A hundred aliases need a hundred separate proofs, and the proof is Licensed plasterer lath record with guild workshop stamp, earned by 3-year apprenticeship, 165 supervised rooms, theory exam, guild dues. The gate charges per key, and the farm holds 545 keys: 137 POA per key, 74665 POA total, before the epoch pays out. One real apprenticeship beats a hundred printed certificates, every epoch.
